service_id.title: Service ID
service_id.description: Identifies the service in its MQTT topics.

poll_interval_s.title: Poll interval
poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between two regular query rounds of the service.

diagnostic_poll_multiplier.title: Diagnostics multiplier
diagnostic_poll_multiplier.description: Diagnostic values are queried less often than the other values. The factor multiplies the poll interval.

http_timeout_s.title: HTTP timeout
http_timeout_s.description: Seconds the service waits for the HTTP response of a device before the query counts as failed.
